import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"ids\":[0]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/people/bulk_activate", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
